payload.title: Boundary: VideoML is renderer for VideoJob, not the publicity calendar
payload.description:
Parked boundary — do not implement. Not in progress.

## Boundary

VideoML is the **renderer** for VideoJob, not the publicity calendar. File this as a child on **Babulus** (not a VideoML code change).

Chattic bots claim VideoJob by state. Babulus owns the job record, Campaign, Slot, and SharePayload. VideoML does not grow Campaign/Slot types.

No VideoML implementation from this issue.
